title: Conditional Indirect Effect of Brand Trust on Purchase Intention Through Commitment at Levels of Brand Familiarity

rows.effect: B. Conditional indirect effect of X on Y through M

notes.general: N = 344. X = brand trust, M = affective commitment, Y = purchase intention, W = brand familiarity. X and W were mean-centered. Path coefficients use OLS standard errors; conditional indirect effects and the index of moderated mediation are bootstrapped with 5,000 resamples (bias-corrected, 95% CI). Moderated mediation is inferred when the CI of the index excludes zero. Model corresponds to PROCESS Model 7 (W moderates the a path).
specific: W values are reported at −1 SD, the mean, and +1 SD; MW = 4.02, SDW = 1.14.
